title: Persistence probabilities of autoregressive chains with continuous innovations
summary: We consider the persistence probabilities of an autoregressive chain of order one with continuous innovations. In the case of positive drifts, we show that these persistence probabilities are compound-geometric and satisfy a Baxter-Spitzer factorization generalizing that of the random walk. In the case of negative drifts, we exhibit a discrete Van Dantzig problem, which implies that the Baxter-Spitzer factorization never happens, except in a degenerate case.
